drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Counsel,

Please find attached our revised draft of the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. We have made minor edits to clarify the confidentiality obligations and terms of the agreement. We look forward to your comments.

Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential and proprietary information related to such transaction.
edits.name: Clarify Purpose Clause

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. The receiving party shall protect all disclosed confidential information from unauthorized use or disclosure for a period of three years from disclosure, using at least the same degree of care as it uses to protect its own information but no less than a reasonable degree of care.
edits.name: Expand Confidentiality Clause

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement shall remain in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing unless terminated earlier by either party with thirty days written notice; however, obligations of confidentiality shall survive termination as stated herein.
edits.name: Clarify Term and Survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. In the event of breach, the non-breaching party may seek injunctive relief and damages, without waiving any other rights or remedies available at law or equity.
edits.name: Expand Remedies Clause
